scenarios.title: Damage dealt to Wolverine heals the damage already marked on it
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Wolverine, Fierce Fighter, tapping Mountain.

variants.label: wolverine
variants.expected: The 2 damage is dealt and the 4 damage already marked on Wolverine is healed: Wolverine (3/5) has 2 damage marked and stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: no_heal
variants.delta: B's creature is Great-Horn Krushok (3/5, no abilities) with 4 damage marked instead of Wolverine.
variants.expected: Great-Horn Krushok has 6 damage marked and moves to B's graveyard in the state-based check.

scenarios.title: Pyramids removes all damage marked on a land instead of destroying it
decisions: A activates Pyramids ({2}, tapping both Forests), choosing the mode 'the next time target land would be destroyed this turn, remove all damage marked on it instead' and targeting Dryad Arbor.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.
A passes priority; B casts Shock targeting Dryad Arbor, tapping Mountain.

variants.label: pyramids_active
variants.expected: Dryad Arbor (1/1 land creature) is dealt 2 damage; instead of being destroyed, its marked damage is removed. Dryad Arbor stays on the battlefield with 0 damage marked.

variants.label: no_pyramids
variants.delta: A does not activate Pyramids; the first two decisions are dropped.
variants.expected: Dryad Arbor is dealt 2 damage and moves to A's graveyard in the state-based check.

scenarios.forge_notes: Pyramids is a one-shot replacement effect created by the activation; it lasts for the turn or until used.
